Executives and Scientists Print Minus Related Pages On This Page Senior Executive Services Senior Level Scientific/Professional How to Apply The Senior Executive Service (SES) is comprised of the men and women charged with leading the continuing transformation of our government. This dedicated corps of executives shares a commitment to public service and a set of democratic values grounded in the fundamental ideals of the Constitution. Note: Currently unavailable due to the government-wide Hiring Freeze. Search Executives Jobs Search Scientist Jobs Senior Executive Service (SES) SES positions include most managerial, supervisory, and policy positions classified above General Schedule (GS) grade 15 or equivalent positions in the Executive Branch of the Federal Government. The position must meet SES functional criteria as defined in the law. Senior Level (SL) SL positions include positions that are not SES positions and are classified above GS-15 based on non-executive duties and responsibilities, which may include research and development functions consistent with published position classification standards and guides and accepted classification principles. Scientific/Professional (ST) ST positions include position classified above GS-15 that are not SES positions (i.e., do not involve executive and management responsibilities) and are engaged in research and development in the physical, biological, medical, or engineering sciences, or a closely related field. How to Apply Candidates can apply directly to a federal agency for a specific SES/SL/ST position, or they may apply for an SES Candidate Development Program, which can lead to eligibility for a career appointment to an SES position without further competition.
